mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, T.* FROM (SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, O.ORDER_DT AS orderDt, O.TOTAL_AMT AS totalAmt FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = '40' AND O.CLOSE_YN = 'N' AND O.ORDER_DT = #{baseDt} ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID) T WHERE ROWNUM <= #{_skiprows} + #{_pagesize}) WHERE RN > #{_skiprows}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_DAILY_SALES T USING (SELECT #{salesDt} AS SALES_DT, I.PRODUCT_ID, SUM(I.QTY) AS QTY, SUM(I.AMT) AS AMT FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM I WHERE I.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} GROUP BY I.PRODUCT_ID) S ON (T.SALES_DT = S.SALES_DT AND T.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SALES_QTY = T.SALES_QTY + S.QTY, T.SALES_AMT = T.SALES_AMT + S.AMT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SALES_DT, PRODUCT_ID, SALES_QTY, SALES_AMT, REG_DT) VALUES (S.SALES_DT, S.PRODUCT_ID, S.QTY, S.AMT, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT D.SALES_DT, C.CATEGORY_NM, P.PRODUCT_NM, D.SALES_QTY, D.SALES_AMT FROM TB_DAILY_SALES D JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = D.PRODUCT_ID JOIN TB_CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE D.SALES_DT = #{baseDt} ORDER BY D.SALES_AMT DESC
